name: BMI Calculator
description: Estimate body mass index from height and weight to screen weight status categories.
interpretationNotes: BMI is a screening tool, not a diagnostic test.
Athletes and elderly may need alternate assessments.

faq.question: Can I rely on this BMI information instead of a doctor visit?
faq.answer: No. This content supports learning and preparation for conversations with qualified healthcare professionals. It is not a substitute for diagnosis or treatment.
